subject.title: Feature request: add prefix/list-style skill discovery to ClawHub CLI search

question: Should deterministic skill enumeration be added as bounded modes on `/api/v1/search`, or as a paginated prefix/exact filter on the registry list/catalog surface?
rationale: The current durable contract says search is relevance retrieval rather than browse fallback, while the issue requires reliable enumeration and counting that a capped search response may not guarantee.

options.title: Add paginated catalog filters
options.body: Keep ranked search intact and add exact/prefix filters to a stable, cursor-based registry listing API and CLI command.

options.title: Adopt bounded search modes
options.body: Approve the linked PR's exact and prefix search modes, documenting the cap and that prefix results are not necessarily a complete registry count.

options.title: Retain relevance search only
options.body: Decline enumeration guarantees and document that users must browse or resolve known slugs individually.

recommendation.title: Add paginated catalog filters
recommendation.body: Keep ranked search intact and add exact/prefix filters to a stable, cursor-based registry listing API and CLI command.

likelyOwner.reason: The latest current-main search contract commit establishes the product boundary that this decision would modify.
